title: Tool calls
description: Tool call volume, error rate and duration across every workspace, the tools that fail most, and every bot's calls. Read from the obs model (ADR-0046).

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls made in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Tool error rate
panels.description: Calls whose result was an error, as a share of calls that got a result.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS error_rate FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS error_rate FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Calls without a result
panels.description: Calls whose run ended, or is still going, without a result for them.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS no_result FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome = 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS no_result FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome = 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Median duration
panels.description: Median time from a call to its result.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT p50 AS median_ms FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p50 FROM (SELECT duration_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER () AS pct_n FROM (SELECT duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked) q
targets.queryText: SELECT p50 AS median_ms FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p50 FROM (SELECT duration_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER () AS pct_n FROM (SELECT duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked) q

panels.title: p95 duration
panels.description: 95 % of calls got their result within this time.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT p95 AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT duration_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER () AS pct_n FROM (SELECT duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked) q
targets.queryText: SELECT p95 AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT duration_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER () AS pct_n FROM (SELECT duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked) q

panels.title: Bots calling tools
panels.description: Bots that made at least one tool call in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT bot_id) AS bots FROM tool_calls WHERE called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT bot_id) AS bots FROM tool_calls WHERE called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Tool calls per hour by outcome
panels.description: Tool calls per hour, stacked by ok, error and no result.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', called_at) AS time, outcome, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', called_at) AS time, outcome, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Error rate per hour
panels.description: Errors as a share of the calls that got a result, per hour.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', called_at) AS time, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS error_rate FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', called_at) AS time, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS error_rate FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: p95 duration per hour by tool family
panels.description: The 95th percentile of call duration per hour, one line per MCP server; tools of the agent loop itself are built-in.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, family, p95 FROM (SELECT time, family, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT time, family, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time, family ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time, family) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', called_at) AS time, coalesce((CASE WHEN substr(tool_name, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' AND instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__') > 0 THEN substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 1, instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__')) END), 'built-in') AS family, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY time, family) q ORDER BY time, family
targets.queryText: SELECT time, family, p95 FROM (SELECT time, family, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT time, family, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time, family ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time, family) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', called_at) AS time, coalesce((CASE WHEN substr(tool_name, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' AND instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__') > 0 THEN substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 1, instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__')) END), 'built-in') AS family, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY time, family) q ORDER BY time, family

panels.title: Top failing tools
panels.description: The tools with the most errors in the time range, their error rate and the runs affected.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tool_name, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, count(*) AS calls, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN outcome <> 'no_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error_rate, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN run_id END) AS runs, max(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN called_at END) AS last_error FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY tool_name HAVING sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY errors DESC, tool_name LIMIT 20
targets.queryText: SELECT tool_name, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, count(*) AS calls, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN outcome <> 'no_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error_rate, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN run_id END) AS runs, max(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN called_at END) AS last_error FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY tool_name HAVING sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY errors DESC, tool_name LIMIT 20

panels.title: Tool families
panels.description: Calls and errors per MCP server; tools of the agent loop itself are built-in.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT coalesce((CASE WHEN substr(tool_name, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' AND instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__') > 0 THEN substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 1, instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__')) END), 'built-in') AS family, count(*) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC, family
targets.queryText: SELECT coalesce((CASE WHEN substr(tool_name, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' AND instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__') > 0 THEN substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 1, instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__')) END), 'built-in') AS family, count(*) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC, family

panels.title: Tools
panels.description: Per tool: calls, errors, calls without a result, error rate and the median, p95 and longest time from call to result.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t.tool_name, t.family, t.calls, t.errors, t.no_result, 100.0 * t.errors / nullif(t.calls - t.no_result, 0) AS error_rate, q.p50 AS p50_ms, q.p95 AS p95_ms, t.max_duration_ms FROM (SELECT tool_name, coalesce((CASE WHEN substr(tool_name, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' AND instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__') > 0 THEN substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 1, instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__')) END), 'built-in') AS family, count(*) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'no_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result, max(duration_ms) AS max_duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY tool_name) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT tool_name, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT tool_name, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tool_name ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tool_name) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT tool_name, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY tool_name) q ON q.tool_name = t.tool_name ORDER BY t.calls DESC, t.tool_name LIMIT 100
targets.queryText: SELECT t.tool_name, t.family, t.calls, t.errors, t.no_result, 100.0 * t.errors / nullif(t.calls - t.no_result, 0) AS error_rate, q.p50 AS p50_ms, q.p95 AS p95_ms, t.max_duration_ms FROM (SELECT tool_name, coalesce((CASE WHEN substr(tool_name, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' AND instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__') > 0 THEN substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 1, instr(substr(substr(tool_name, 6), 2), '__')) END), 'built-in') AS family, count(*) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, sum(CASE WHEN outcome = 'no_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result, max(duration_ms) AS max_duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY tool_name) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT tool_name, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT tool_name, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tool_name ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tool_name) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT tool_name, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL AND outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY tool_name) q ON q.tool_name = t.tool_name ORDER BY t.calls DESC, t.tool_name LIMIT 100

panels.title: Bots
panels.description: Per bot: calls, errors, error rate, calls without a result, distinct tools, and the median and p95 duration.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT b.workspace_name, b.bot_name, b.calls, b.errors, 100.0 * b.errors / nullif(b.calls - b.no_result, 0) AS error_rate, b.no_result, b.tools, q.p50 AS p50_ms, q.p95 AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT coalesce(c.bot_id, '') AS bot_key, max(n.workspace_name) AS workspace_name, max(coalesce(n.bot_name, c.bot_id)) AS bot_name, count(*) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN c.outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, sum(CASE WHEN c.outcome = 'no_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result, count(DISTINCT c.tool_name) AS tools FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT bot_key, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT bot_key, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bot_key ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bot_key) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT coalesce(bot_id, '') AS bot_key, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY bot_key) q ON q.bot_key = b.bot_key ORDER BY b.calls DESC, b.bot_name
targets.queryText: SELECT b.workspace_name, b.bot_name, b.calls, b.errors, 100.0 * b.errors / nullif(b.calls - b.no_result, 0) AS error_rate, b.no_result, b.tools, q.p50 AS p50_ms, q.p95 AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT coalesce(c.bot_id, '') AS bot_key, max(n.workspace_name) AS workspace_name, max(coalesce(n.bot_name, c.bot_id)) AS bot_name, count(*) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN c.outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, sum(CASE WHEN c.outcome = 'no_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result, count(DISTINCT c.tool_name) AS tools FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT bot_key, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN duration_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT bot_key, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bot_key ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bot_key) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT coalesce(bot_id, '') AS bot_key, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE outcome <> 'no_result' AND called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND called_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY bot_key) q ON q.bot_key = b.bot_key ORDER BY b.calls DESC, b.bot_name

panels.title: Tool errors by bot
panels.description: Which bot's calls of which tool failed, and in how many runs.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT n.workspace_name, n.bot_name, c.tool_name, count(*) AS errors, count(DISTINCT c.run_id) AS runs, max(c.called_at) AS last_seen FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.outcome = 'error' AND c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY errors DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT n.workspace_name, n.bot_name, c.tool_name, count(*) AS errors, count(DISTINCT c.run_id) AS runs, max(c.called_at) AS last_seen FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.outcome = 'error' AND c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY errors DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Newest errors
panels.description: The newest calls whose result was an error. A run id opens the run view.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT c.called_at, n.bot_name, c.tool_name, c.duration_ms, n.status AS run_status, c.run_id FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.outcome = 'error' AND c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY c.called_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT c.called_at, n.bot_name, c.tool_name, c.duration_ms, n.status AS run_status, c.run_id FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.outcome = 'error' AND c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY c.called_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Calls without a result
panels.description: The newest calls that never got a result, with the run's status. A run id opens the run view.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT c.called_at, n.bot_name, c.tool_name, n.status AS run_status, c.run_id FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.outcome = 'no_result' AND c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY c.called_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT c.called_at, n.bot_name, c.tool_name, n.status AS run_status, c.run_id FROM tool_calls c LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.outcome = 'no_result' AND c.called_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND c.called_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY c.called_at DESC LIMIT 50
